title: Tiny, cute envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='envGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7d6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd97a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='flapGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffc94d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- envelope body -->
  <rect x='22' y='34' width='56' height='38' rx='4' fill='url(#envGrad)'/>
  <!-- bottom fold shading -->
  <path d='M22 68 L50 52 L78 68 Z' fill='#ffcf66'/>
  <!-- lower diagonal seams -->
  <path d='M22 72 L46 52 L54 52 L78 72 Z' fill='#ffe6a3' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- side seams lighter -->
  <path d='M22 34 L50 58 L50 52 L26 34 Z' fill='#fff1c2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M78 34 L50 58 L50 52 L74 34 Z' fill='#fff1c2' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- open flap -->
  <path d='M22 34 L50 14 L78 34 L50 52 Z' fill='url(#flapGrad)'/>
  <path d='M22 34 L50 14 L78 34' fill='none' stroke='#ffb733' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- cute face on the flap -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='30' rx='3' ry='3.6' fill='#5a3b12'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='30' rx='3' ry='3.6' fill='#5a3b12'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='1' fill='#fffbe8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='1' fill='#fffbe8'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='34' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9d9d' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='34' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9d9d' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 36 Q50 40 55 36' fill='none' stroke='#5a3b12' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little heart seal at bottom -->
  <path d='M50 64 C47 60 42 60 42 64 C42 67 50 71 50 71 C50 71 58 67 58 64 C58 60 53 60 50 64 Z' fill='#ff6b8a'/>
</svg>
